title: ingest-conservation-guard: receipts of bucket conservation for data ingestion
description: Schema validation tells you whether one row is well formed; nothing tells you whether the set survived the transform. This package emits receipts of bucket conservation for data ingestion, migrations and catalogue sync, holding the identity dominio == imagen + rechazos + sin_clave + colisiones. Every bucket is counted by its own pass over the input and never derived from the others, because a derived bucket closes in the integers even when the counts are incompatible (68 + 0 + (-1) = 67). Exit codes are a contract: 0 conserved, 1 merged, 4 broken, and a guard that only ever returns success is indistinguishable from no guard. Zero dependencies, standard library only; receipts are deterministic and replayable without the wheel.
